summary: Ziro Airport (ZER/VEZO) is a domestic airport serving the town of Ziro in the Lower Subansiri district of Arunachal Pradesh in northeastern India. Nestled in a scenic valley surrounded by pine-covered hills, it provides vital air connectivity to one of India's most culturally distinctive regions, home to the Apatani tribe. The airport primarily supports regional flights operated by Alliance Air and has gained recognition due to the popular Ziro Festival of Music held annually nearby.
faqs:
Q: Which airlines operate flights to Ziro Airport?
A: Alliance Air is the main carrier operating scheduled flights to Ziro, typically connecting it with Guwahati and other northeastern Indian cities.

Q: When is the best time to fly to Ziro?
A: The best time to visit is between March and October, with September being especially popular due to the Ziro Festival of Music. Flights may be subject to weather-related cancellations during the monsoon season.

Q: Are there any landing challenges at Ziro Airport?
A: The airport is situated in a hilly valley surrounded by forested terrain, which can occasionally cause flight delays or diversions due to low visibility, fog, or adverse weather conditions.

Q: Does Ziro Airport operate at night?
A: No, Ziro Airport operates only during daylight hours, with all flights scheduled between sunrise and sunset.
transport_tips: The airport is located about 8-10 km from Ziro town, and travelers typically rely on prepaid taxis or shared vehicles for the roughly 20-30 minute journey. Road connectivity from the airport to nearby towns can be slow due to hilly terrain and limited infrastructure, so allow extra time when planning connections. During the Ziro Festival of Music in September, transport options may be limited and pricier, so booking in advance is recommended.
local_tip: Pack light layers even in summer, as Ziro's valley elevation brings surprisingly cool mornings and evenings, and carry some cash since ATMs and digital payment acceptance can be unreliable in this remote part of Arunachal Pradesh.
